Name: Mystery Box Retexture for Natural Accent UI
Author: thirtythreepaces
Description:
Hello! This is a simple mod that retextures the mystery box and golden mystery box items using assets from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21865]Natural Accent Interface[/url] by sinistea, which changes the box sprites in the UI, but not the actual items. This mod fixes that!
[b]
To install:[/b][u][b]
[/b][/u][list]
[*]Make sure you have SMAPI and the latest version of Content Patcher (at least 2.2.0) installed.
[*]Download, unzip, and place “[CP] Natural Accent UI Mystery Boxes” into your mods folder.
[*]Done!
[/list]
If you like this mod, you might also like my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25006]Prize Ticket Retexture for Vanilla and Natural Accent UI[/url]!

Manifest.Name: Natural Accent Mystery Boxes
Manifest.Description: Changes the sprites of the mystery boxes to match Natural Accent UI.
